name: Revenue Performance Advisor
headerDescription:
A package for every size and budget. Optimize your financial interactions, maximize revenue streams and boost patient satisfaction with our tailored suite of tools designed to suit your needs and budget.

*Each bundle has required implementation fees in addition to monthly charges.
paymentSchedule: No payment is required to check out at this time; all charges will be invoiced.

contractTerms.headerDescription: Save money with a longer term. A longer initial contract term offers significant savings compared with a one-year contract. Also, save time with auto renewal. Automatically extend your contract to save time and prevent service disruption.

optionItems.headerDescription: Accelerate your setup process. Whether you prefer support of a DIY approach or need a comprehensive build-out in your environment, we've got you covered to get up and running swiftly and smoothly.

optionLineItems.longDescription: With Standard Implementation, our team configures the product and provides an overview. It also includes access to training videos and webinars so you can gain valuable insights and guidance.
With a Batch File Implementation, an FTP location will be provided so that your claims can be sent to the RPA solution via an x12 batch file using secure file transfer protocol (SFTP).

optionLineItems.longDescription:
Commercial Medical Attachments streamline your practice’s workflow by letting your staff attach commercial medical documents directly to the claim and send it to the payer electronically.

For payers who don’t accept digital attachments, we can send that attachment by fax or mail.

Workers' Comp Attachments streamline your practice’s workflow by letting your staff attach workers' comp documents directly to the claim and send it to the payer electronically.

For payers who don’t accept digital attachments, we can send that attachment by fax or mail.
Printed Claims produces the primary claim on paper.

Claims Submission and Tracking helps you avoid timely and costly resubmissions, including Medical Necessity and Correct Coding Initiative edits.

It also gives you increased visibility into the entire process which helps you not only get it right, but get it done faster.

Eligibility and Benefits provides batch requests, real-time requests, and/or an API to connect to over 1,500 payer connections that helps to:
  • Reduce eligibility-based denials
  • Lower costs associated with reworking denials
  • Reduce bad-debt write-offs from uncovered, unpaid services
ERAs/Payer Payments provides details concerning the adjudication of a claim.

optionLineItems.longDescription:
Card-Not-Present Payment Transaction delivers rapid payment processing without a physical card. Supported cards are:
  • Credit
  • Debit
  • HSA
  • FSA

Any Card-Not-Present payment transaction for an amount more than $9,999.99, or payments processed using a payment card issued for insurance reimbursements (e.g., virtual cards or v-cards) will be subject to an additional fee of a percentage of the payment transaction amount.

SmartPay Plus helps hospitals and health organizations improve revenue performance through an omni-channel payment approach that:
  • Improves the patient financial experience
  • Simplifies and automates collection workflows
  • Simplifies and automates financial communications

SmartPay Plus with Merchant Services streamlines workflows and reporting while consolidating vendors. Includes all merchant processing fees (interchange, card association fees, authorization, assessments, etc,) and P2PE gateway fees, if applicable.
